scenario:
A major baseball league is developing an enterprise-level analytics platform to track and analyze player performance statistics across different games. The platform is designed to provide coaches, analysts, and managers with detailed insights into player performance against various teams. This includes metrics such as games played, at-bats, runs scored, hits, extra-base hits (doubles, triples, home runs), runs batted in, bases on balls, strikeouts, stolen bases, and other key performance indicators.

The system should allow for the aggregation of statistics by game and season, providing comprehensive reports on player performance trends. It should support advanced analytics capabilities to highlight strengths and weaknesses against different opponents. Additionally, the platform should integrate predictive analytics to forecast future performance based on historical data.

User roles and permissions must be implemented to ensure secure access to sensitive data, with customizable dashboards for different user types, including team management, coaching staff, and analysts. The system should facilitate collaboration between teams and provide real-time updates and alerts for in-game strategy adjustments.
